from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAssetRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial fact about a single company's fixed assets from one report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full legal name of the company from the report")
    fixed_assets_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical ending balance of Fixed Assets")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit stated in the report (e.g., '元')")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The specific reporting period (e.g., '2024 年第一季度')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the value and line item")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_asset_records: list[CompanyAssetRecord]
